about: Fix G. W629 gives the switch settings and defers the actual backup/restore procedure to Cat. No. W501, which is not in this machine's knowledge base. The original conversation answered with an invented six-step procedure and only admitted at the very end that W501 was missing.
question: Giv mig hele trin-for-trin proceduren for at tage backup til SD-kort på NX502, fra start til slut.

says that manual is not in the knowledge base
